cohort: Women who consented to TOLAC within a strict protocol between 2006 and 2013 at a single center
finding: Epidural use during TOLAC was associated with a significantly lower rate of in-labor cesarean delivery and a higher likelihood of VBAC, without increasing the risk of adverse maternal-neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Epidural analgesia at TOLAC was associated with a significantly lower rate of in-labor cesarean delivery and a higher likelihood of VBAC.
